reviewer_note: Review ran in the same context that produced the artifacts (a single fork; nested workers unavailable). The blind Codex reads are independent; Claude's reconciliation is not, and carries authorship bias. Mechanical checks passed on every promoted surface: no hex/rgb/hsl literal, every var(--bd-*) resolves, data-bd-product scope present, illustrative marker present, no external resource, no script. Vendored tokens .source-sha = f652565 = authority head at review time (no drift). authority-doctor: CONNECTED, profile resolved by authority (recorded in state.json). Every promoted artifact is in the stage's viewed list with a content hash.
verdict: fix these first — no contract violation; four should-fix patterns recur across surfaces and the implementation must not inherit them

findings.finding: Display-size page/inspector headings dominate the screen; a console's focal element is the claimed card or the refusal, not the heading.
findings.evidence: Blind reads, unprompted: graph → 'The large "Dependency graph" heading' is the most dominant element; epic → 'The large "Dashboard rewrite…" heading in the right-hand panel'; task → 'The large "FE board, backlog, epics screens" task heading'.
findings.fix: Implementation uses --bd-text-h2 for canvas titles and --bd-text-h3 for the inspector title; no display size inside the shell.

findings.finding: Ornamental taglines under H1s ('Resume from claim, blocker, then proof.', 'Open an epic. Resume from its record.') — banned by the surface rules.
findings.evidence: Blind read (sessions) lists 'Resume from claim, blocker, then proof.' under Page header; Claude confirmed in render.
findings.fix: No taglines. Empty states carry the one-line next action instead.

findings.finding: Canvas content squeezed into a ~480px centred column at 1440; health round 1 additionally overflowed horizontally (fixed in round 2).
findings.evidence: Playwright 1440×900 renders; health-1440-dark round 1 was 1730px wide.
findings.fix: Canvas content fills the canvas up to ~1100px, left-aligned; forms are two-column above 1200px.

findings.finding: The open <dialog> collapses at 390px: the status chip becomes a giant pill and the buttons stretch into tall columns.
findings.fix: Modal primitive: intrinsic-height flex column, buttons in a row that wraps; test at 390 in the browser scripts.

findings.finding: Priority coloured (danger red on 'high'); the profile says priority is a word plus a glyph, never a colour. Id column wraps 'TM-' / '049'.
findings.evidence: backlog-1440-dark.png rows 1, 3, 5; blind read names 'cyan' and 'black' only, so the red is not even carrying signal.
findings.fix: Priority chip uses text-secondary; id column min-width fits the longest id.

findings.finding: Card titles clamp to one line with an ellipsis; the board card should show 2–3 lines before clamping so the title is readable without opening the card.
findings.evidence: Blind read lists 'Define stable board…', 'Render acceptance…' etc. as truncated titles.
findings.fix: line-clamp: 3 on card titles; full title in aria-label.

findings.finding: Status chips are fully rounded pills. The surface rules allow pills on status chips only; every blind read reports pills solely on status/filter chips.
findings.evidence: Blind reads Q5 across board, task, graph, epic, backlog, sessions.
findings.fix: None — sanctioned use. Keep --bd-radius-full to chips only.

findings.finding: Invented heading 'Resume from record' and a wrong command (`tm task show`); the store verb is `tm show`.
findings.fix: Drop the heading; command blocks come from the real verb list in the contract.

findings.finding: A 'Current claim' card was added to the sub-navigation that the spec never asked for (the rail-the-IA-never-asked-for reflex).
findings.fix: Not implemented; the command bar already carries the active claim.

findings.finding: Ghost 'Search' label overlaps the command-bar placeholder.

Generated-art contract holds: no UI, copy, logos, numbers; exactly one lit element (none in the ground piece); accent as an edge seam. Hue is the model's saturated blue prior — never read colour from these.
findings.evidence: Blind reads: hero 'No UI controls, charts, logos, words, or numbers'; ground 'no identifiable controls…'; og 'one glowing blue line along that tile's front edge'.
